body:
Summary For the quarter, the PGIM Government Income Fund Z returned 0.34% net of fees, and underperformed the Bloomberg U.S. Aggregate Ex-Credit Index, gross of fees. In Q2, the Fed's policy reaction function shifted from "wait-and-see" with an easing bias to "wait-and-see" with a relatively low bar for hiking rates. During the period, overall security selection was the largest contributor to the Fund's performance, with selection in MBS and U.S. sovereign credits contributing the most.
